text.aria-label: Title text 'CRPS at days 1 to 10 on five slices, each arm minus its control (R; A for _pre). Estimates only: the slices hold few half-hours (cold overcast: 769 and 911), so no interval. Cold: under 5 C. Sunny: clear-sky index above 0.6. Overcast: below 0.3.'
text.tspan: CRPS at days 1 to 10 on five slices, each arm minus its control (R; A for _pre).
Estimates only: the slices hold few half-hours (cold overcast: 769 and 911),
so no interval. Cold: under 5 C. Sunny: clear-sky index above 0.6. Overcast: below 0.3.
